div.div: طِبِّيخٌ , (A, L, K,) written by Aboo-Bekr طَبِّيخ, with fet-h to the ط, (L,) i. q. بِطِّيخٌ [The melon; or particularly the water-melon]: (L, K:) of the dial. of El-Hijáz, (L,) or of El-Medeeneh. (A.) [Freytag says that, accord. to some, but he does not not name his authority, it is a large, round melon, rough to the touch, and without a neck, different from the بطيخ, which is a small melon.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
